Constraints & Preferences: Never deploy on Fridays. Staging cluster is stg-eu-3 (stg-eu-2 retired). Prefer brief log output where possible.
Progress: Migration 0042 applied on staging. Deployed to staging with the canary step disabled for that run only (it was flaky). Error rate 0.2%, normal.
Next Steps: prepare the production rollout plan.
